questions.title: Who will have the #1 lab rank on Arena AI's overall Text Arena leaderboard on December 27, 2026?
questions.background:
According to Google AI, Text Arena is "the text-to-text evaluation mode and leaderboard where users compare responses from two anonymous AI models to a text prompt and vote on which one is better."

`{"format": "bot_tournament_question", "info": {"hash_id": "1b47969c3fb5a071", "sheet_id": "147"}}`
questions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the lab with the highest Lab Rank (i.e., the first row) on the Arena AI [Text Arena](https://arena.ai/leaderboard/chat/text?rankBy=labs) Overall leaderboard when first accessed by Metaculus on or after December 27, 2026.
